_comment: Pass/fail limits for 4 concurrent streaming sessions over a 15 min window. See .ptah/specs/main-loop-sync-blocks/perf-eval-plan.md for the justification of each limit.

watchdog.hangEvents.note: No >5 s main-loop block. The user-visible freeze.

watchdog.blockedPct.note: Share of the window spent blocked by a watchdog hang.

watchdog.unrecoveredHangs.note: App must never stay hung until killed.

eventLoop.maxMs.note: Worst single lag. The main process only logs lags >= ~250 ms, so this means: no logged lag above 500 ms.

eventLoop.maxOfP99Ms.note: p99 lag reported by any warning interval.

gitGate.maxWaitMs.note: A git slot is never waited on longer than 30 s.

gitGate.saturatedEvents.note: Occasional saturation tolerated, not a stacked queue.

sqlite.maxMs.note: No slow statement above 1 s on the main thread.

rpc.git:info.maxMs.note: git probes must not stack behind the gate.

rpc.memory:search.maxMs.note: Handler latency only: the loop-lag limits above are what prove it no longer blocks.

slowRpc.maxMs.note: No RPC handler of any method above 30 s.

rendererFrames.maxMs.note: Only meaningful once the RendererFrame diagnostic lands; 0 observed counts as pass.

logVolume.stormMinutes.note: No minute above the storm threshold (500 lines/min by default).
